categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai HIUV New Materials Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of special polymer films, focusing on photovoltaic (PV) encapsulation films used in solar modules. The company also develops new high-quality materials for automotive applications, including smart glass dimming films, lightweight eco-friendly leather, and glass encapsulation films. Its business segments include PV encapsulation materials and emerging automotive new materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary polymer formulations, self-designed production equipment, and advanced processing technologies. Key technologies include EVA and POE encapsulation films with anti-PID, anti-hydrolysis, and multi-layer co-extrusion capabilities, as well as innovative products like zero-migration light-transmitting films, instant liquid crystal dimming films, and lightweight eco-friendly synthetic leather. Production follows a sales-driven model with rigorous quality control and continuous R&D to maintain technological leadership.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are leading photovoltaic module manufacturers and automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, focusing on the renewable energy and new energy vehicle sectors. The company serves markets requiring high-performance encapsulation films for solar modules and advanced polymer films for automotive interiors and smart glass applications. It also targets high-end building materials and consumer goods sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with multiple production bases across Shanghai, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and other provinces. It has subsidiaries in Singapore, Vietnam, and Australia, supporting international production and sales. Overseas markets include Southeast Asia and other global renewable energy and automotive markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai HIUV New Materials operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, producing specialized polymer films that serve as critical materials for downstream photovoltaic module assembly and automotive component manufacturing. It procures raw materials like EVA and POE resins upstream and sells finished films downstream to module and automotive manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in advanced polymer materials, focusing on enhancing PV encapsulation film performance, developing new automotive smart films, and expanding into emerging applications like perovskite solar cells and AI-enabled optical devices. It emphasizes innovation in product formulations, equipment automation, and cost reduction. Strategic initiatives include international cooperation, market diversification, and sustainable product development aligned with green energy and low-carbon trends.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of high-performance polymer films to photovoltaic module manufacturers and automotive suppliers. The company also licenses technology and provides technical services. Sales are predominantly contract-based with framework agreements and monthly orders, focusing on product sales rather than subscription or licensing fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a technology leader and one of the main suppliers in the Chinese photovoltaic encapsulation film industry, competing with other domestic and international film manufacturers. It holds a strong market position due to its rapid product innovation, technical expertise, and stable relationships with leading module manufacturers. In automotive materials, it is an emerging innovator with proprietary products and growing market acceptance.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 2.59 billion, a 46.81% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to lower sales volume and pricing pressures in the PV film market. It incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB -558 million, reflecting intensified industry competition and asset impairment charges. The company’s total assets decreased by 40.10% to RMB 3.22 billion, with ongoing investments in R&D accounting for 4.55% of revenue. Despite current losses, the company maintains positive operating cash flow and is investing in new business growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai HIUV New Materials emphasizes its proprietary polymer formulations, rapid product iteration, and integrated technology platform combining materials, equipment, and processes. Its encapsulation films offer superior durability, anti-degradation properties, and efficiency enhancement for solar modules. In automotive applications, its innovative dimming films and eco-friendly synthetic leather provide unique functional and environmental benefits. The company’s value proposition centers on delivering high-quality, customized, and technologically advanced polymer films that enable customers to improve product performance and sustainability.
